meta.name: Latch — grant the pausable role to the ops key (optional; before the custody accept executes)
meta.description: CLAUDE.md's ownership table assigns PausableRole.hasPausableRole to Ops; on chain neither pool-manager owner grants it to 0x304b0cc0 (hasPausableRole reads false on both). grantPausableRole is onlyOwner. While the Safe is still owner this is a direct 2-of-3 call; once the NEW custody timelock's acceptOwnership executes (48h after the custody batch) it becomes a 48h queued operation. Pause-only power: pausePoolManager is onlyPausableRoleOrOwner, unpause stays onlyOwner. Not required for the handover; included because this is the last cheap moment to do it.
